evidence.quote: Valar Atomics announced a partnership with Nvidia to explore AI data centers powered directly by advanced nuclear energy, marking a first for the industry.
evidence.one_line: Valar Atomics announced a partnership with Nvidia to explore AI data centers powered by advanced nuclear energy (Wednesday, 2026-07-01 announcement).
evidence.speaker: Valar Atomics

evidence.quote: The companies are considering a 30-megawatt, nearly waterless data center in Utah using Valar’s Ward250 reactor and Nvidia’s water-efficient cooling technology.
evidence.one_line: Companies are considering a 30 MW, nearly waterless AI data center in Utah powered by the Ward250 reactor with Nvidia cooling technology.
evidence.speaker: Deseret News (reporter)

evidence.quote: Valar Atomics and Nvidia are exploring the deployment of a 30 megawatt data center, fully powered by their nuclear reactor.
evidence.one_line: Valar and Nvidia are exploring deployment of a 30 MW data center fully powered by the Ward250 reactor.
evidence.speaker: Deseret News (reporter)

evidence.quote: Their reactor, the Ward250, went critical on June 18, and it is now generating 100 kilowatts of electricity.
evidence.one_line: Valar's Ward250 reactor went critical on June 18 and is generating 100 kilowatts of electricity.
evidence.speaker: Deseret News (reporter)

evidence.quote: The proposed size is 300 times smaller than the approved Stratos data center in Box Elder County.
evidence.one_line: The proposed 30 MW data center is 300 times smaller than the approved Stratos data center in Box Elder County.
evidence.speaker: Deseret News (reporter)

evidence.quote: Before Valar Atomics can generate power commercially, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission will need to license their reactor. In a recent editorial board meeting with the Deseret News, NRC chairman Ho Nieh said the commission is hoping to shorten federal licensing review times to less than 18 months.
evidence.one_line: NRC chairman Ho Nieh said the commission hopes to shorten federal licensing review times to under 18 months.
evidence.speaker: Ho Nieh

evidence.quote: “Valar Atomics is the company that is done waiting for someone else to unleash the power of the atom,” he said on Wednesday.
evidence.one_line: Isaiah Taylor's company statement on Valar's approach to nuclear power (no figure).
evidence.speaker: Isaiah Taylor

evidence.quote: The fuel inside the Ward250 will let it continue running for 165 years, Taylor said.
evidence.one_line: Taylor said the fuel in the Ward250 will let it run for 165 years.
evidence.speaker: Isaiah Taylor

evidence.quote: The Ward250’s helium cooling system, combined with Nvidia’s new technology, will allow the data center to operate with almost no water use.
evidence.one_line: The reporter says the Ward250 helium cooling plus Nvidia technology will allow almost no water use at the data center.
evidence.speaker: Deseret News (reporter)

evidence.quote: Nvidia recently announced its new AI factory design, DSX, which uses a highly water-efficient direct liquid cooling system. Water pumped through the factory remains at 113°F to eliminate the need for power-hungry water chillers.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia recently announced DSX AI factory design using direct liquid cooling with water at 113°F, eliminating water chillers.
evidence.speaker: Deseret News (reporter)

candidates.question: Will Nvidia and Valar Atomics sign a binding agreement for the 30 MW nuclear-powered Utah data center by 2027-06-30?

rungs.label: Yes
rungs.condition: A signed agreement between Nvidia and Valar Atomics for the Utah data center is announced by 2027-06-30

rungs.label: No
rungs.condition: No such signed agreement is announced by 2027-06-30
